summary: Iteration 53 - Arrears Payment Plans end-to-end testing. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering POST/GET/DELETE payment plan + payments endpoint, validation (400 no arrears, 400 past-week start, 400 >104 instalments, 400 bad date, 400 over remaining), duplicate 409, emailed field, oldest-first application to rent_payments, completed status on full payoff, broken detection via direct Mongo start_date mutation (on_track=False, status='broken', broken_at set), portfolio.arrears returns plan field and next_auto_on=None when fully covered, remind-arrears returns 400 'Nothing to chase...', run_auto_reminders() skips covered months, tenant portal HTML includes payment-plan card with schedule, and deleting a tenancy cascades-deletes its payment plans. Frontend: /arrears mobile screen rendered correctly for the seeded 'Plan Test' tenancy (ON TRACK, £500 of £3,600 paid, next £500 26 Oct, reminders paused), all testIDs present (arrears-plan-, arrears-plan-status-, arrears-plan-log-, arrears-plan-cancel-, payment-plan-sheet, plan-log-amount-input, plan-log-date-input, plan-save-button). Login flow works via auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button. No React Native issues, red screens, or deprecated-package warnings seen in this flow.
critical_code_review_comments: payment_plans.create_plan rejects start dates older than today-7d but allows arbitrarily far-future dates; this is probably intentional (lets landlords agree a plan ahead of first paycheque) but worth confirming the product intent.

In payment_plans.log_instalment, if the remaining > 0 after applying to all plan months (e.g. tenant_rent changed), the leftover 'left' amount is silently dropped from the ledger but still counted toward plan.paid. Low-risk edge-case but worth a comment.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a tenancy prefixed TEST_, factory cleans them up per-test, and a module-scope autouse cleanup sweep deletes any surviving TEST_* and the seeded 'Plan Test' tenancy at module teardown as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Login testIDs: auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button. The /arrears screen requires that at least one tenancy already has overdue rent (the demo seed has 'Plan Test' with 4 months arrears and an active plan). For plan creation UI testing, create a fresh tenancy with no plan - the 'Agree a payment plan' button (arrears-plan-create-{tid}) only renders when t.plan is null. Server date observed ~2026-10-19.
